paras: Przewalski's gecko (Phyllopezus przewalskii) or Przewalski's gecko, is a species of gecko, a lizard in the family Phyllodactylidae. The species is endemic to South America.
The specific name, przewalskii, is in honor of Russian naturalist Nikolay Przhevalsky.
P. przewalskii is found in Argentina, Bolivia, Brazil, and Paraguay.
The holotype has the following measurements: total length 123 mm (4.8 in); head, 20 mm (0.79 in); body, 50 mm (2.0 in); tail, 53 mm (2.1 in).
